skills.name: Recalling Greatness
skills.description: You recognize your true past and potential as you recover your lost memories.

skills.name: Noble Fire
skills.description: Tap your noble spirit to protect your charges from powerful opponents.

skills.name: Artistic Recall
skills.description: Return to Ristonia, the city of art.

skills.name: Martial Discipline
skills.description: Reinforces the foundations of a warrior.

skills.name: Blade of Will
skills.description: Creates a sword from magic that slashes in front of you.

skills.name: Magic Dispatch
skills.description: Creates a magical shard that hunts down an enemy. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Jaunt
skills.description: Allows you to double jump. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Jaunt
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI. effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: High Rise
skills.description:
Steel your mind to project magic, suspending you in the air for a short time and allowing you to use aerial skills. Use the skill in the air or press the up key twice in a row to activate. Effect canceled when you use it again or use another movement skill.
Right-click to lock command.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI. effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Glint
skills.description: Cuts through enemies like a flowing beam of light.

skills.name: Aether Crystal
skills.description: Attacking with the aether sword sometimes gathers the surrounding energy into crystals. Using Resonance Rush will send you rushing towards the crystal.

skills.name: Aether Forge
skills.description:
Creates a number of aether swords around your body using all available aether.
The created aether swords attack nearby enemies on their own and are unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle the effect On/Off

skills.name: Aetherial Arms
skills.description: Automatically creates shards when attacking.

skills.name: Bladecaster Control
skills.description: Increases Bladecaster Mastery, Attack Power, and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Will to Live
skills.description: Grants the qualities needed to survive. Additionally, permanently increases Final Damage and Ignore Defense.

skills.name: Elite Training
skills.description: Train your Strength to become ever more powerful.

skills.name: Aether Weaving
skills.description:
Refine magic from around you to be used for special aether swords.
Aether can be obtained at regular intervals or by defeating enemies.

skills.name: Skewering
skills.description: [Trigger Skill] Creates multiple longswords that strike to the front.

skills.name: Impale
skills.description:
Creates an aether sword that can be launched in 8 directions depending on the directional key pressed.
The sword vanishes at the limit of its range, leaving an aether crystal that replaces any existing crystal, regardless of creation cooldown.
Can chain with Resonance Rush, but will not create an aether crystal if chained.

skills.name: Resonance Rush
skills.description:
Creates a large aether sword that resonates with a nearby aether crystal, causing you to rush towards the crystal. This can be used in 8 directions depending on the directional key pressed.
Can only be used when an aether crystal is in range, or if chained from Impale.
If chained from Impale, the sword conjures faster and it follows in the direction of Impale.

skills.name: Resonance Rush
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Weave Infusion
skills.description: Increases Bladecaster Attack Speed for a short time.

skills.name: Aether Forge
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Aether Forge
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Aether Forge
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Ascent
skills.description: Grow ever more powerful in the quest to improve yourself.

skills.name: Tolerance
skills.description: Increases resistance to various hazards. Additionally, permanently increases Final Damage and Ignore Defense.

skills.name: Eviscerate
skills.description: [Trigger Skill] Conjures 2 longswords that slash in a cross.

skills.name: Reign of Destruction
skills.description: Summons countless swords across a large area. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Noble Summons
skills.description:
Orders aether swords affected by Hunting Decree to return in a straight line, striking enemies along their path, then group together for a moment. In Targeting Mode, aether swords will head toward enemies marked by Grave Proclamation. This only applies if there are enemies within the attack range of Hunting Decree. Can only be used when there is at least one aether sword pursuing an enemy through the Hunting Decree skill.
Noble Summons will not decrease the aether swords' duration.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns.
Right-click to toggle the Targeting Mode On/Off

skills.name: Hunting Decree
skills.description:
Command nearby aether swords created with Aether Forge to pursue enemies in combat. Can only be used when there are aether swords present.
If you and the aether swords are separated, those swords will return to attack.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
When the pursuing aether swords disappear, aether can be obtained proportionate to their remaining duration.

skills.name: Feather Float
skills.description:
Float back like a feather and remain aloft for a short time.
You can move while using Trigger skills other than Plummet.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: True Nobility
skills.description:
Summons up your noble spirit to sacrifice for your allies. Within the spirit field you create, you receive some of the damage dealt to party members (including yourself), and form a shield in proportion to it.
Not affected by effects which increase buff durations. Immediately canceled if you use it again.

skills.name: Bladecaster Expertise
skills.description: Increases Bladecaster Mastery, Attack Power, and Damage.

skills.name: Perfection
skills.description: Perfects your technique through rigorous training.

skills.name: Ruination
skills.description: Master a powerful attack that blows past enemy defenses.

skills.name: Strive
skills.description: Reach the level of a master through constant battle.

skills.name: Aether Mastery
skills.description: Discover a new level of aether control.

skills.name: Trigger - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases damage of Trigger skills.

skills.name: Trigger - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases amount of enemy DEF Trigger skills ignore.

skills.name: Trigger - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases Boss Damage of Trigger skills.

skills.name: Resonance Rush - Efficiency
skills.description: Generates aether when aether crystals vanish after Resonance Rush, and Impale no longer consumes aether.

skills.name: Reign of Destruction - Persist
skills.description: Increases duration of Reign of Destruction.

skills.name: Aether Bloom - Cooldown Cutter
skills.description: Reduces the cooldown of Aether Bloom.

skills.name: Will to Live - Aura Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Will to Live recovery.

skills.name: True Nobility - Shield Reinforce
skills.description: Damage increases if a shield is present during True Nobility.

skills.name: Aether Guard - Persist
skills.description: Increase the max key-down time of Aether Guard.

skills.name: Cleave
skills.description: [Trigger Skill] Creates a massive sword to cut enemies ahead of you.

skills.name: Grave Proclamation
skills.description:
Marks enemies for annihilation with a cursed sword, making them a prime target for your aether swords, Magic Dispatch, and Shardbreaker.
If the skill is used when another enemy is marked, the first mark vanishes.
Grave Proclamation prioritizes enemies with the highest Max HP within range.

skills.name: Plummet
skills.description: [Trigger Skill] Wrap your body in potent magic and dive upon your foes.

skills.name: Aether Bloom
skills.description:
Releases a bloom of magic from each Hunting Decree sword. Can only be used while at least one aether sword is under Hunting Decree.
The duration of the aether sword doesn't elapse during Aether Bloom, and the aether swords that return with Noble Summons cannot bloom.
Unaffected by attack reflection, and isn't affected by effects which reset cooldowns.

skills.name: Aether Guard
skills.description:
Shield yourself with spinning aether swords to block enemy attacks, reduce damage, and mitigate debilitating status conditions. Not affected by effects which reset cooldowns.
If you are attacked as soon as it's cast, the damage of that attack is nullified and the damage from the next attack is reduced. Can be used while using Trigger skills, except for Plummet.

skills.name: Hero of the Flora
skills.description: Your hidden potential as a Flora increases your stats. Using the skill creates a Flora emblem.

skills.name: Floran Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Blade Torrent
skills.description:
Attacks with countless magic swords to overwhelm enemies.
Foes stunned by this skill cannot be stunned again for 90 sec.

skills.name: Shardbreaker
skills.description:
Fills the shard with magic to make it first grow, then shatter.
Magic refocuses in the location where it shattered to create an aether crystal, regardless of cooldown.

skills.name: Divine Wrath
skills.description: Borrows strength from the ancient god of the Flora.

skills.name: Ruin
skills.description:
Summons the ancient sword of destruction to cause a massive collapse.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Infinity Blade
skills.description:
Creates a space filled with countless aether swords. The command only works on nearby swords, and if you are separated the swords will return to attack.
Aether swords created from Infinity Blade are only affected by the effects of Grave Proclamation and not Noble Summons or Aether Bloom.
Unaffected by attack reflection. Pursues enemies only when Adele is in combat.
skills.note: effect (1 frames) is a blank timing sequence in the source WZ (1x1 frames); omitted.

skills.name: Legacy Restoration
skills.description:
Temporarily restores the lost magical conduit and the enchanted wings of the past.
Legacy Restoration is unaffected by attack reflection, and using the skill again will immediately end the skill.

skills.name: Storm
skills.description: All aether swords commanded by Hunting Decree sweep around you in a wild current. With Hunting Decree, gather illusions around your person in proportion to the number of swords hunting for the enemy. Storm is unaffected by attack reflection, and the skill can be used again to immediately end it.
